paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Yehudah, Jerusalem Talmud. In Rabbah, Tzav, section 7: Rabbi Abba bar Yudan in Rabbi Yehudah bar Simon’s name. G.A.Y.: half a day from the city of Paras are buried Rabbi Abba son of Rabbi Yehudah, Rabbi David, Rabbi Ovadyah, Rav Sechora, and Rabbi Abba.
